title: Handyman Services
headline:
The small jobs most
homes need every year.
shortDescription: General home repairs, drywall, doors, fixture installs, mounting, and the punch-list work that piles up on a homeowner's weekend — done by a uniformed crew, written quote, branded truck.
lead: Most homes have a running list of small jobs that never quite get done — a sticking door, a hole in the drywall, a ceiling fan that needs swapping, a TV that needs mounting. Our handyman service is built for exactly that list. Two-person crews, branded trucks, and a written quote before any work starts. Billed hourly with a one-hour minimum at $95/hr, or $85/hr in 4-hour blocks for bigger punch-list days. Most jobs schedule within 1–2 weeks; urgent fixes sooner where the crew has open slots.

sections.heading: Common handyman jobs
sections.intro: A representative — not exhaustive — list of what our crew handles on a typical week.

items.label: Drywall repair and patching
items.body: Doorknob holes, anchor pulls, water-damage cuts, and full sections. Texture-matched and ready for paint, or paint included on request

items.label: Interior and exterior doors
items.body: Sticking doors, hinge resets, weatherstripping, full slab swaps, and pre-hung replacements. Hardware swaps and lockset installs

items.label: Fixture installs
items.body: Ceiling fans, light fixtures, vanity faucets, garbage disposals, smoke and CO detectors. Larger electrical jobs route to our electrical team

items.label: Mounting and assembly
items.body: TV mounts, floating shelves, mirror and art hanging, IKEA-style assembly, and child-safety anchoring of furniture

items.label: Caulk, grout, and trim
items.body: Re-caulk tubs and showers, grout repair, baseboard and crown work, quarter-round at floors. Small carpentry

items.label: Punch-list days
items.body: End-of-renovation cleanup work, move-in punch lists, rental turnover lists. Block-rate pricing makes a long list cheaper than ten small visits

sections.heading: How a handyman job goes
sections.body: Most handyman jobs follow the same arc.
items: Phone call or web request — describe the list, send photos if you have them
Phone-quote for short jobs; on-site walkthrough for anything we can't price by photo
Two-person crew arrives in a branded Apex truck with the parts and tools listed in the quote
Walkthrough at the end, photos of completed work, payment by card or check on-site
